authority.units: ControllableUnitState is authoritative for farmer/dog position, owner, HP, armor, command and queue.
authority.chickens: EconomyChickenState is authoritative for chicken position, owner, HP and aiState.
authority.buildings: PlayerBuilding is authoritative for completed/construction state, footprint, owner, HP, armor and targetableByWolves.
authority.enemies: SP-07-03 creates one runtime enemy registry; CombatPocSystem private combatWolves must not become a second normal-run authority.
authority.snapshot: SP-07-02 returns copied observations only; it must not write HP, command, cooldown or lifecycle state.

targeting.construction: Constructing buildings are not attack targets in SP-07. Completed buildings use targetableByWolves; exact construction-damage behavior remains absent until a later explicit contract.
targeting.distance: Unit attacks use center-to-center distance plus target radius. Building attacks use the nearest point of the target footprint.

combatRules.damage: Apply max(1, rawDamage - targetArmor), clamp HP to zero, and reject a damage call whose target is already dead or removed.
combatRules.cooldown: Consume an attacker cooldown only after its damage entry point accepts a living target. A rejected or missing target consumes no new cooldown.
combatRules.lineOfAttack: SP-07-06 defines visibility and line policy. Terrain and dynamic blockers remain movement/pathing blockers until that card makes a combat-line decision; no attack may pass through an unvalidated blocker as an implementation shortcut.
combatRules.death: The transition to HP zero is idempotent. It clears focus, current command, queue and path as applicable, then uses the existing unit/building/economy removal callback exactly once.
combatRules.refund: Enemy destruction of a completed building gives no refund, matching SP-05-01. Paid construction cancellation retains its separate 75% refund rule.
combatRules.farmerOutcome: Farmer death hands off revival, final defeat and simulation stop to SP-11. SP-07 only emits and cleans up death state. Dog, chicken and ordinary-building loss never independently causes defeat.

orders.directAttack: A direct player attack tracks the specified live enemy until it dies, is removed, becomes invalid or the player replaces/stops the order.
orders.attackMove: Store the original destination separately from a temporary acquired target. After the target dies, disappears or is released, continue to the original destination; do not turn the temporary direct-attack command into the permanent order.
orders.queue: Stop or replacement clears active combat pursuit. Shift commands remain FIFO; an invalid dead-target command is discarded and the next queued command is polled.
orders.wolves: W3X issues Player(10) units an attack order into a broad farm rectangle on spawn/entry and refreshes it every 60 seconds. SP-07 supplies target acquisition/pathing only; SP-08 owns spawn rectangles, periodic population and wave scheduling.

firstDefensePath: Start normal P3 at the farmer coordinate with the standard farmer/dog pair.
Use the existing build-card route to construct fence_wood at the known static-safe input and let it complete.
Build a tower_scout through the same real construction lifecycle at a separately validated non-overlapping WPM point; SP-07-01 does not invent a tower coordinate without a static grid assertion.
SP-07-03 explicit enemy fixture will approach the completed defense. This is fixture-only evidence and is not a natural wave.
normalP3StaticReplay.reasonForFixture: Normal starts create no runtime enemy because combat/combatSmoke are false and SP-08 owns wave spawning. The first actual combat evidence therefore needs an explicit fixture enemy after SP-07-03.

w3x: combat_unit_stats_reference.tsv: H000 farmer and n002 dog attack ground/structure targets; n007 timber wolf attacks ground, structure, debris, item and ward targets.
jass_wolf_order_flows.tsv: Player(10) wolves receive an attack order into IlIlI on spawn/zone entry and a 60-second refresh; JASS does not state a concrete farmer/chicken/building priority.
key_unit_placement_reference.tsv: wolf stones, neutral spiders and central NPCs are static placement records, not proof that their combat lifecycle exists in the web runtime.
webConversion: balance.ts is canonical for current web combat values; its farmer/dog/timber-wolf values intentionally differ from extracted W3X values and are not an exact stat port.
buildingSystem.ts already has completed-tower target search and damage callback seams, while normal main.ts constructs CombatPocSystem only behind combat/combatSmoke flags.
controllableUnitSystem.ts already models direct attack and attack-move, but attack-move replaces itself with direct attack and cannot restore its original destination.

deferred.SP-08: spawn rectangles, wave timing, population, replenishment and transitions
deferred.SP-09: tech enforcement, production and upgrade UI
deferred.SP-11: revival, victory, defeat and game shutdown
deferred.SP-12: wolf stones, spiders, central NPCs and other event content
